title: ‘A tax on being thin’: only high earners make overall savings on food bills from weight-loss drugs

paragraphs.en: The high cost of weight-loss medication is a “regressive tax on being thin” because the outlay outweighs any saving on food costs for all but the highest earners.
paragraphs.zh: 减肥药物的高昂费用是一种“对变瘦征收的累退税”，因为除了收入最高的那部分人之外，这笔开销超过任何食品开销上的节省。

paragraphs.en: Someone needs to have discretionary income of nearly £100,000 a year to actually save money after covering the £1,200 annual cost of GLP-1 medication, according to an analysis by the consultancy Baringa.
paragraphs.zh: 根据咨询公司Baringa的分析，一个人每年必须有近10万英镑的可自由支配收入，才能在支付每年1200英镑的GLP-1药物费用后真正省钱。

paragraphs.en: “Our analysis shows that GLP-1s risk becoming a driver of inequality,” said Paddy Winters, a partner at Baringa. “Only very high earners will benefit from savings to their groceries whilst taking the GLP-1 pill.”
paragraphs.zh: “我们的分析显示，GLP-1药物有成为不平等驱动因素的风险。”Baringa合伙人帕迪·温特斯说，“只有收入极高的群体才能在服用GLP-1药片的同时从食品采购的节省中获益。”

paragraphs.en: A regressive tax is one that takes a larger percentage from lower-wage earners’ income compared with those who are more wealthy. Most users buy the drugs with a private prescription.
paragraphs.zh: 累退税是指从低收入者的收入中扣取的比例高于较富有者的税种。大多数使用者通过私人处方购买这类药物。

paragraphs.en: A GLP-1 user with £39,000 left over after tax and essentials will spend £481 less a year on food. But it is not until someone has £97,500 left to spend after tax and other outgoings that their grocery spend is reduced by £1,200, according to Baringa. The cost is an average for the pill form of the medication.
paragraphs.zh: 根据Baringa的数据，一名在纳税和基本开支后还剩3.9万英镑的GLP-1使用者，每年在食品上会少花481英镑。但只有当一个人在纳税和其他支出后仍有9.75万英镑可花时，其食品采购支出才会减少1200英镑。这一成本是片剂形式药物的平均费用。

paragraphs.en: For “everyone else” the annual cost of the drug outweighs any reduction in spending on groceries, Winters said. “On top of that, users are spending more on vitamin supplements and personal care products like hair care, to manage side effects. In effect, GLP-1s become a regressive tax on being thin.”
paragraphs.zh: 温特斯说，对“其他所有人”来说，这种药物的年成本都超过了食品采购支出的任何减少。“此外，使用者还在维生素补充剂和护发等个人护理产品上花更多钱，以应对副作用。实际上，GLP-1药物成了一种对变瘦征收的累退税。”

paragraphs.en: “We’re already seeing early signs that some people cancel their prescription after a few months because the cost adds up – but the weight comes back once you stop,” he added. “So the pattern is likely to be start, stop, regain and return, and to fund that cycle, we may well see people turn to debt.”
paragraphs.zh: 他补充说：“我们已经看到一些初步迹象：有些人在几个月后取消了处方，因为费用不断累积——但一旦停药，体重就会反弹。因此，这种模式很可能是开始、停药、反弹、再回归，而为支撑这一循环，我们很可能会看到有人转向举债。”

paragraphs.en: There are 14.3 million adults living with obesity in England, according to the King’s Fund . In a recent report, the charity said the government “needs to ensure that the people who benefit from [weight-loss medication] most are not priced out of accessing them, and that we don’t end up with wider health inequalities caused by obesity due to affordability and access”.
paragraphs.zh: 根据国王基金（King's Fund）的数据，英格兰有1430万成年人患有肥胖症。在这家慈善机构最近的一份报告中，它表示政府“需要确保最能从（减肥药物）中受益的人不会被价格排除在外，并且我们最终不会因为可负担性和可及性问题，出现由肥胖导致的更广泛健康不平等”。
